Description.SourceString:
Looking upon Dowdun Reach, you would struggle to find anything that doesn’t scream “we worship the god of chaos!”. The walls are adorned with the red flags of Zamorak, the windows bear his mark, and everything is decorated with just a little more malice than any normal architect would attempt.

This place once served as a warning, reminder and invitation, depending on who approached. To the villagers of Fellhollow, it was a warning that they were straying too far from the comforts of home. To those wishing to proselytise their faith, it was a reminder that the residents within the keep were not interested. Finally, those to whom chaos had a place in their hearts, the flags, the décor and the sinister sensation was a welcoming invitation, bringing them home.
